title: Acceptable Use Policy Attestation
description: A record showing employees have acknowledged an organisation's generative AI acceptable-use policy, together with configuration records for any technical control (e.g. DLP tooling) enforcing it.
evidence_description: A record of which employees have completed acceptable-use policy training and attestation for third-party generative AI tools, plus the current configuration of any technical control (DLP rules, approved-tool allowlist) enforcing that policy.
collection_method: HR/training-system attestation records combined with an export of the DLP or endpoint-security tool's active configuration.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of attestation completion and technical-control configuration.

citations.title: Samsung Bans ChatGPT, Google Bard, Other Generative AI Use by Staff After Leak
